issues.detail: The Hebrew name יְהוֹשָׁפָט (Jehoshaphat) is rendered as 'Ê-xu' (Esau) instead of 'Giô-sa-phát' or similar. This is a different person.
The Hebrew עַל יִשְׂרָאֵל means 'over Israel' (i.e., he strengthened himself over/with regard to Israel), not 'chống lại Y-sơ-ra-ên' ('against Israel'), which reverses the relationship.
